scope: Owner-only JPEG, PNG and WebP image attachments at most 8 MiB, encrypted opaque storage, message acceptance linking, protected download, cleanup and recovery coverage. Existing browser voice remains local and browser-native. No live target was contacted.

checks.evidence: In-app browser observation at http://127.0.0.1:4317/: mobile composer visibly exposes Attach image, Voice input, Send and the JPEG/PNG/WebP 8 MiB limit

limits: The image check verifies binary signatures and structural end/length markers; it deliberately does not decode, transform, preview or inspect image metadata.
The browser observation confirms the rendered composer controls. Automated HTTP coverage validates transfer and retrieval; it does not claim a production GoDaddy upload rehearsal.
No live provider, GoDaddy application, database migration or external scanner was used.
